errors.evidence: The description states the 2015 value for 60% of the median wage as 10,59 Euro, but the figure shows 10,59 as incorrect; the correct value is 10,82 Euro (within tolerance, but 10,59 is clearly wrong based on the image).
The description states the 2025 value for 60% of the median wage as 15,12 Euro, but the figure shows 15,12 as incorrect; the correct value is 14,12 Euro (outside tolerance).

The description refers to the purple bars as 'Dunkelviolettt mit diagonalen Streifen,' but the figure shows solid purple bars with only the 2024 and 2025 bars having a dashed pattern, not diagonal stripes for all bars.
The description does not explicitly mention the dashed pattern is only for the years 2024 and 2025 in the purple bars.
The description omits the exact position of the legend (below the diagram).

errors.text_span: Jedes Jahr wird durch zwei nebeneinander angeordnete Balken repräsentiert: der linke Balken in Hellblau steht für den „Gesetzlichen Mindestlohn (Jahresmittelwert)“, und der rechte Balken in Dunkelviolettt mit diagonalen Streifen steht für „60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten“. Die Höhe der Balken entspricht den jeweiligen Werten, die direkt über den Balken angegeben sind.
errors.evidence: The description is unnecessarily repetitive in explaining the color coding and bar arrangement, which is already clear from the legend.
